About the Madams

A fandom built by the trentahins, a FANmILY open to everyone.

🌱 Established August 18, 2025
◆ Our Story

Madams of WilBea is a fan-led community organized for the trentahin-and-above WilBea family — a multigenerational space where age does not define enthusiasm, and where every member is welcomed, celebrated, and seen.

We came together over a shared love for WilBert Ross and Bea Binene, and stayed for each other. What started as a place to gush over a love team has grown into something warmer: a home where kilig and kindness live side by side, and where no one is ever too old to feel the flutter.

Kilig has no expiration date. Fangirling (and fanboying!) is timeless.
◆ Who We're For

Built by the trentahins, open to all

We proudly began as a space for the thirty-and-above — the ones who grew up, grew wiser, and never stopped swooning. But our doors are open to every generation. Younger fans, older fans, quiet lurkers and loud kiligeras alike: if your heart still flutters, there's a seat for you here. We didn't build a clique. We built a FANmILY — a fandom that became a family.

◆ The Governing Body

The Madams' Circle

Behind every welcome, every event, and every drop is The Madams' Circle — the community's official stewards. Eleven members strong across six committees, the Circle leads not by standing above, but by standing with. As our manifesto puts it: the Madams of WilBea was never meant to be ruled — it was meant to be tended.

◆ What We Stand For

Our Promise

Every decision we make returns to the values that founded us:

🤗
Inclusivity
Every age, every fan — a seat for everyone.
💚
Joy
Kilig, laughter, and the fun of fangirling together.
🕊️
Mutual Respect
Grace and dignity for every Madam, every time.
🏡
Love
Home is where kindness lives. Let's keep it that way.
This is our Circle. This is our promise.
This is our home. 💚
